scenes.title: ¡Bienvenidos! — Papel picado
scenes.subject: Several strings of Mexican papel picado banners hanging in gentle arcs: rectangular tissue-paper flags in hot pink, orange, turquoise, yellow, purple and green, each with intricate cut-out patterns of flowers, birds and skulls, glowing as if backlit
scenes.motion: The papel picado banners flutter, bounce and dance merrily in a lively breeze while bright confetti swirls around them.

scenes.title: Piedra del Sol
scenes.subject: The Aztec Sun Stone (Piedra del Sol) seen straight on: a perfectly circular carved disc with the face of the sun god Tonatiuh in the center, tongue out, surrounded by the four Nahui Ollin panels and concentric rings of the twenty day signs and sun rays, rendered in glowing polished gold with warm amber light in the deep carvings
scenes.motion: Spins two full turns like a wheel facing the camera with a happy bounce and shimmer (rendered locally from the still, not by AI).

scenes.title: Chichén Itzá — El Castillo
scenes.subject: El Castillo, the Temple of Kukulcán at Chichén Itzá: the Maya stepped pyramid with nine square terraces, a steep staircase on each of its four sides and a small temple on top, shown as a floating miniature on a thin cut-out slab of green grass, three-quarter view, warm golden sunset light on the limestone
scenes.motion: The pyramid makes one complete 360-degree turn at a steady speed while colorful fireworks in red, green, white, pink and gold burst and sparkle in the darkness above it like a Mexican fiesta. The pyramid itself is not lit up or changed by the fireworks, and the fireworks fade away before the end.

scenes.title: Teotihuacán — Pirámide del Sol
scenes.subject: The Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacán: a massive stepped pyramid of rough grey-brown stone with five broad tiers and a long central staircase, shown as a floating miniature on a thin cut-out slab of earth with a short stretch of the Avenue of the Dead, lit by a warm orange sunrise glow
scenes.motion: The pyramid makes one complete 360-degree turn at a steady speed while a few colorful hot-air balloons rise gently around it and drift away before the end.

scenes.title: Cabeza colosal olmeca
scenes.subject: A colossal Olmec stone head: a giant basalt sculpture of a man's face with a broad flat nose, full lips and a close-fitting helmet with ear flaps, three-quarter view, the dark stone lit by strong teal and gold rim lights so every edge glows
scenes.motion: The colossal head looks around curiously from side to side, breaks into a big friendly smile and gives a cheerful wink, then returns to its starting pose.

scenes.title: El águila y el nopal
scenes.subject: The founding legend of Tenochtitlan: a golden eagle with wings half spread, perched on a prickly pear cactus (nopal) that grows from a rock, holding a rattlesnake in its beak and talons; bright green cactus paddles with red tuna fruits, the eagle's feathers glowing bronze and gold
scenes.motion: The eagle proudly spreads its wings wide and flaps them triumphantly, the snake coils, and bright pink and yellow flowers bloom on the cactus.

scenes.title: Palacio de Bellas Artes
scenes.subject: The Palacio de Bellas Artes in Mexico City: its white marble Art Nouveau facade with arched windows and sculptures, crowned by the large central dome tiled in orange, yellow and gold, shown as a floating miniature on a thin cut-out slab of plaza, lit at night with warm golden floodlights
scenes.motion: The building makes one complete 360-degree turn at a steady speed while colorful confetti and streamers drift down around it and are gone before the end.

scenes.title: Ángel de la Independencia
scenes.subject: The Angel of Independence monument in Mexico City: a tall slender stone column on a stepped base with bronze statues, topped by a shining golden winged Victory statue holding a laurel wreath, shown whole as a floating miniature, the golden angel glowing brightly
scenes.motion: The monument makes one complete 360-degree turn at a steady speed while red, white and green fireworks burst in the darkness around the golden angel like an Independence Day celebration, fading away before the end.

scenes.title: Mariposas monarca
scenes.subject: A swirling round cloud of dozens of bright orange-and-black monarch butterflies with white-spotted wing edges, wings open, glowing warm orange
scenes.motion: The monarch butterflies flutter happily and swirl in a playful, bouncy spiral dance around the center of the frame.

scenes.title: Ajolote
scenes.subject: A cute pink axolotl (ajolote) floating as if underwater, with six feathery coral-red external gills, tiny black eyes, a gentle smile, little four-fingered legs and a long finned tail, soft glowing pink skin
scenes.motion: The axolotl wiggles happily, does a playful little twirl and waves a tiny hand with a big smile, its feathery gills waving, while a few small bubbles float up.

scenes.title: Voladores de Papantla
scenes.subject: The Voladores de Papantla ritual: a tall wooden pole with a small square frame at the very top where a musician stands playing a flute and drum, and four performers in red pants and white shirts with colorful ribbons and conical headdresses hanging upside down from ropes, arms outstretched, flying around the pole
scenes.motion: The four voladores fly in joyful wide circles around the pole, ribbons streaming, while the musician on top dances and plays.

scenes.title: Ballet Folklórico
scenes.subject: A Ballet Folklórico dancer in a traditional Jalisco dress mid-twirl, holding a huge ruffled full-circle skirt out wide, the skirt in bright red, white and green with rows of colorful ribbons, hair in braids with ribbons, full body visible
scenes.motion: The dancer twirls joyfully with a big smile, swinging her huge skirt so it flares out in full colorful waves, ribbons flying.

scenes.title: Alebrije
scenes.subject: A fantastical Oaxacan alebrije creature, part jaguar and part dragon with small wings and a curled tail, carved wood painted with intricate patterns of dots, stripes, zigzags and flowers in hot pink, turquoise, yellow, orange and purple, full body visible
scenes.motion: The alebrije dances playfully: it bounces, wiggles its tail, flaps its little wings and happily turns all the way around.

scenes.title: Máscara de lucha libre
scenes.subject: A Mexican lucha libre wrestling mask in shiny gold and red fabric with flame designs around the eye and mouth openings and a white trim, worn on an invisible head so it keeps its full shape
scenes.motion: The mask makes one complete 360-degree turn at a steady speed with a lively little bounce while colorful confetti bursts around it like a wrestling-ring entrance, gone before the end.

scenes.title: Regalos de México al mundo
scenes.subject: Foods Mexico gave the world floating in a neat ring around an empty center: an ear of yellow corn, an open cacao pod showing its beans, a red chili pepper, a halved avocado with its pit, a ripe red tomato, and vanilla pods with a pale vanilla orchid flower
scenes.motion: The foods dance in a happy circle around the center, bouncing and spinning playfully.

scenes.title: Piñata
scenes.subject: A traditional Mexican seven-point star piñata: a round center with seven cone-shaped points, covered in layers of fringed tissue paper in hot pink, orange, yellow, turquoise and purple, with long colorful streamers hanging from each point
scenes.motion: The piñata swings back and forth merrily and spins, its colorful streamers flying, while confetti falls around it.

scenes.title: La Catrina
scenes.subject: La Catrina, the elegant Day of the Dead skeleton lady, head and shoulders portrait: a white sugar-skull face decorated with colorful floral designs, wearing a large wide-brim hat adorned with feathers and bright orange cempasúchil marigold flowers, and a lace collar
scenes.motion: La Catrina sways and dances joyfully with a big smile, her hat feathers bouncing, as orange marigold petals swirl around her.
